Exalt 
- Play Short Blade 3x
- L once marked Gold, play Short Blade into Long Blade to combine and fuse into Whalefall
- L which in Turn, would also unlock your Exalt
- If incapable of using Exalt (or you want to use OE instead,) play Deadly Duel to use the Aliemus of her Allies to Battery herself
- Use Exalt / OE, only when you are guaranteed to die due to a lot of Damage

PChaos Posse
- Whenever possible, prioritize Triple Posse (Triphase Relevation) over Double-Play (Dual Recurrence) 
- Select Posse based on these criterias
- To activate Awakener's Exalts, prioritize Aliemus 
- For extended Combos, prioritize Arithmatecia 
- To obtain Telekinesis / Long Blade / Short Blade / Deadly Duel, prioritize Draw / Search
- For burst Turns, prioritize Damage Buffs 
- To generate Keyflare, play as much Cards as possible from your Awakeners for the first time in each Turn

Isn’t “Ability sourced base dmg”, “General card base dmg” and “General base dmg” additive which is “General base damage” in the infographic while “specific command card base damage” multiplicative with this?
no, they all multiply with each other. You can easily test this by using for example E3 kath with wheels in the other categories. You won't get the correct result if you just add everything.

So display dmg = [(ATK%scaling) * (specific command card base dmg+1) * (general command card base dmg+1) * (general base dmg+1) * (party base dmg+1) * (dmg amp+1) + dmg add] * (party final dmg+1) * (final dmg+1) * (Buff sourced final dmg+1) * (weakness+1). Then for actual dmg multiply by vuln, crit, psychic trauma if applicable. 
Sorry looks like a mess but that's how it works.
As for what I called the categories / layers I just picked the trait I felt they had in common, but maybe there's a more intuitive naming scheme possible.
idk the math works at least
also as stated earlier I haven't tested every form of damage multiplier in the game, far from it, so there may be layers / categories I've missed.
